purpose: BR1/M5 post-reaudit final convergence correctness after forced-COW hot-branch specialization

vulkan_compatibility.claim: Build and contract compatibility only; no active Vulkan device, GPU performance or product qualification.

sampling_and_stop_rule: Exactly one complete run of every listed test on each architecture after one successful build. Preserve every raw log. Do not rerun a failed sample as a replacement.
pass_rule: Every process exits zero; every QtTest log reports zero failed and contains no SAFE ASSERT or FAIL!; the architecture gate and its six tool self-tests pass.
stress_postcondition: The fixed-seed tiles3 stress test drains retirement/history work, has no outstanding capability, has zero reservation in every budget class, and has zero live ActivePending/InFlight/RetirementDebt bytes.
performance_scope: Excluded from this correctness protocol. Selector performance uses its own preregistered matched-control protocol and may remain open independently.
tsan_scope: A separate toolchain capability probe is required. Ordinary stress results do not imply race-detector qualification.

tsan.probe_rule: Compile and execute a two-thread no-race program. If this fails, record TSAN as unsupported on this host. If it passes, a project-instrumented run remains required before claiming PageStore TSAN coverage.
tsan.project_stop_rule: One source-current instrumented run of every listed test; halt on the first TSAN report or test failure; preserve all logs.
tsan.qualification: Supplemental only; deterministic interleaving and resource tests remain authoritative.
